📺 Supergirl (2015–2021)

Supergirl follows Kara Zor-El, a young woman from the planet Krypton who was sent to Earth before her home planet was destroyed. After spending years hiding her extraordinary abilities and living under the identity of Kara Danvers, she finally embraces her destiny as a superhero when she saves her adoptive sister Alex from a dangerous plane accident. Determined to protect National City, Kara begins working alongside a secret government organization to defend humanity against powerful alien threats, dangerous criminals, and unexpected enemies. While balancing her responsibilities as a superhero with her career as a journalist, Kara struggles with personal relationships, family secrets, and the challenges of living in the shadow of her famous cousin, Superman. Starring Melissa Benoist, Chyler Leigh, David Harewood, and Katie McGrath, the series delivers exciting action, emotional storytelling, and inspiring messages about courage, hope, identity, equality, friendship, and discovering the strength to embrace who you truly are.

🎭 Genre: Action • Adventure • Science Fiction • Superhero • Drama

⭐ IMDb: 6.2/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 42 minutes per episode • TV-PG

🎥 Developers: Greg Berlanti, Ali Adler & Andrew Kreisberg

📺 Seasons: 6 • 126 Episodes

📚 Based On: The DC Comics character Supergirl, created by Otto Binder and Al Plastino.

🌎 Universe: DC’s Arrowverse.

📺 Where to Watch: Check Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, and Apple TV for current availability in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: Supergirl is an American superhero drama television series developed by Ali Adler, Greg Berlanti and Andrew Kreisberg that aired on CBS from October 26, 2015, to April 8, 2016, and The CW from October 10, 2016, to November 9, 2021. Based on the DC Comics character created by Otto Binder and Al Plastino, the series follows Kara Zor-El (played by Melissa Benoist), Superman's cousin, and one of the last surviving Kryptonians from the planet Krypton. As Supergirl, Kara uses her powers to protect National City.
